One-time purchase or subscription
(
Updated
:
August 11, 2026
)
CleanMyMac offers several purchase options, including both one-time purchase and subscription. With multiple
marketplaces
and purchase options available, you might wonder which is best for you — a one-time purchase, a subscription from the MacPaw Store or the App Store, or a Setapp subscription. Below are key details about each option to help you decide.
Note
For details about feature differences in CleanMyMac
editions
, refer to
Feature availability and differences
.
One-time purchase
One-time purchase of CleanMyMac is available at both the
MacPaw Store
and the
App Store
. If you make purchase from the MacPaw Store, this also gives you the opportunity to
get
other MacPaw products at a 30% discount.
With a one-time purchase, you pay once and receive a CleanMyMac plan without an expiration date. You can use CleanMyMac as long as it's compatible with your Mac and macOS version. However, a one-time purchase includes only updates and fixes for your current major version of CleanMyMac. For example, a one-time purchase license of CleanMyMac X doesn't include an upgrade to the
latest CleanMyMac
. If you wish to upgrade to a new major version in the future, you can
do so
at a special price.
Subscription
You can get either an annual or monthly CleanMyMac subscription. These subscription options are available at both the
MacPaw Store
and the
App Store
.
Regardless of the marketplace, your subscription includes both updates to the current major version and upgrades to future major versions of CleanMyMac. Additionally, if you choose the MacPaw Store, you can
enjoy
30% off all other MacPaw products.
Subscription renewals occur automatically. If you encounter any issues,
contact
our Support Team.
Setapp subscription
A Setapp subscription not only includes CleanMyMac but also gives you access to over 260 other apps from the
Setapp collection
. Both updates to the current major version and upgrades to future major versions of CleanMyMac are included at no extra cost.
